notes: Tuition fee: the pages state lesgeld per studiejaar only for HBO Voltijd/Deeltijd at Capabel Hogeschool in general (e.g. 'Genoemde bedragen lesgeld zijn per studiejaar') without saying anything for non-EU applicants with a foreign diploma, so no non-EU tuition is stated for this programme and the fact is left out. Teaching languages: no page states the language in which the HBO Bachelor ICT is taught; the B2 Dutch requirement appears on the Verpleegkundige page, not on the ICT page, so teachingLanguages is left out. Intakes: start dates on the ICT page are location-specific (Amsterdam, Apeldoorn, Rotterdam) and no quote attaches the 01 februari 2027 date to an international/non-EU applicant; no dated application deadline for international applicants is given. Documents: the ICT page lists 'Kopie relevant diploma' and 'Kopie ID' for toelating but these are general admission documents, not stated for international applicants. Application channel: no page names Studielink, so applicationChannel is left out. The B2 Dutch requirement quote comes from the Verpleegkundige page and says 'all our programmes are completely in Dutch', which is a general institution-wide statement rather than one about this ICT programme.

note.fr: Vérifiez les conditions d'admission pour les étudiants internationaux (évaluation du diplôme étranger, niveau de néerlandais B2) auprès de Capabel Hogeschool.
note.en: Check the admission conditions for international students (evaluation of foreign diploma, Dutch B2 level) with Capabel Hogeschool.
